jobs.description:
Phorms Education currently runs five bilingual, German-English nurseries within Heilbronn and the surrounding area as part of a cooperation with the Schwarz Group. Another daycare center will open in Bad Friedrichshall at the beginning of 2026. We care for children between the ages of 0 and 6 years in an open and partially immersive concept. Our facilities offer well-equipped functional rooms and outdoor play areas. The pedagogical focus is on bilingualism, music and STEM - the children always remain at the centre of our needs-oriented work and are involved in the day-to-day life of the nursery.

The company nurseries are part of the Phorms Education SE network of bilingual schools and nurseries, that has been enriching the educational landscape in Germany since 2006.

For our nurseries in Heilbronn/Erlenbach/Weinsberg/Bad Friedrichshall we are looking for a motivated and qualified

Early Childhood Educator

(in part-time or full-time)

Our Benefits

- An attractive salary with additional benefits (e.g. company pension scheme, monthly public transport ticket and free, freshly prepared lunch that changes daily)
- A relocation allowance and all paperwork completed and prepared for residency and work permits
- Continuing professional development opportunities
- Open concept with individual support for each child
- Innovative educational concepts and state of the art educational resources
- Short-term provision of employee housing at current market prices for a relaxed arrival

Your Responsibilities  

- Holistic support of our children in the cognitive, emotional, and creative areas
- Preparation and follow-up as well as implementation of parent meetings
- Regular observation of the holistic development and abilities of kindergarten children

Your Profile

- Certified training as an early childhood educator, a degree in education or comparable education that enables you to work as a specialist or supplementary staff member by the respective local authorities
- Identify with our pedagogical concept and are motivated to creatively implement it collaboratively as a team
- Motivated to co-create new pedagogical methodologies to continuously develop with the organisation
- Interest in working in a bilingual and international atmosphere
- Motivated and committed to working as part of a team
- Fluent English skills and German language skills at least level B2

Interested in re-shaping education? Bring your new ideas to life with us and apply now via our website (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/jobs/job/early-childhood-educator/?utm_source=afa&utm_medium=jobanzweb&utm_campaign=BaW%C3%BC_KiTa_Early_Childhood_Educator_engl_0521) .

Please visit jobs.phorms.de (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/overview/)  for more details and do not hesitate to contact Carolin and Lisa, via careers@phorms.de (https://mailto:careers@phorms.de) .

We look forward to your application!

jobs.employer_name: Technische Universität München (TUM), TUM Center for QuantumEngineering (ZQE)
jobs.description:
The research group for the Topology of Correlated Systems at the TUM Center for Quantum Engineering (ZQE) and the Department of Physics is looking for a postdoctoral researcher (f/m/d) to join the BMFTR-funded collaborative project “GarliQ - Green Advanced Refrigerants: Light-element oxides & intermetallics for Quantum cooling” at the earliest possible date. The position is initially limited to 3 years, full-time.

GarliQ is a collaborative project between TUM and kiutra GmbH, funded under the BMFTR call “Enabling Technologies for Resilient R&D Supply Chains in Quantum Technologies”. The project aims to develop new materials with magnetocaloric properties for use as cooling media in adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration (ADR) systems in the millikelvin temperature range - key components of the cryogenic infrastructure for quantum technologies.

Independent synthesis of magnetocaloric material systems (oxide and intermetallic compounds) via solid-state synthesis and melt crystal growth
Structural characterization of the synthesized materials, including by X-ray diffraction
Investigation of magnetic and thermodynamic low-temperature properties using standard and dilution refrigerator cryostats; as applicable, experiments at neutron and synchrotron sources
Determination of magnetocaloric parameters (isothermal entropy change, adiabatic temperature change)
Scale-up of promising synthesis routes for integration into ADR cooling systems, in close coordination with the industrial project partner kiutra GmbH
Supervision of PhD students, master's students, and student assistants within the project
Writing scientific publications for peer-reviewed journals
Presentation of results at national and international conferences

Completed doctorate in physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related field
Solid experience in the synthesis of inorganic solids
Knowledge of structural characterization (powder X-ray diffraction, Laue diffraction, microscopy, …)
Experience with magnetic and thermodynamic measurements (magnetometry, susceptibility, heat capacity, …) at low and ultra-low temperatures
Experience operating crystal growth facilities and/or cryostats
Demonstrated publication record in solid-state physics or materials science
Independent, structured way of working and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is an advantage
Experience supervising students is an advantage
We offer the opportunity to contribute to an internationally visible research topic at the interface of solid-state physics and quantum technologies - in an excellently equipped low-temperature laboratory at the TUM Department of Physics and in close collaboration with an innovative industry partner.
TUM offers a working environment with flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, and open communication, as well as a comprehensive, free range of professional and personal development opportunities.
Remuneration is based on qualifications according to TV-L. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women in its workforce; applications from women are therefore explicitly encouraged.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join Siemens Energy’s Transformers factory network as a Operational Excellence Professional (f/m/d) in Germany and help drive greater efficiency, productivity, and shorter lead times. You will lead continuous improvement and cost-reduction initiatives that support profitable revenue growth across multiple manufacturing sites. Working closely with factory teams, you will share best practices, standardize operating methods, and strengthen Lean ways of working. You will use performance data to identify opportunities, solve operational challenges, and support informed decision-making. Your work will help build a more agile, transparent, and efficient manufacturing organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead process improvement and cost-reduction projects across the Transformers factory network to improve output and cost-effectiveness
* Define project scope, goals, deliverables, and schedules, and collaborate with factory leadership and project sponsors to ensure successful execution
* Facilitate cross-functional workshops and best practice exchanges between manufacturing sites to support operational excellence
* Develop, implement, and maintain standard operating methods, while training and coaching colleagues in Lean methodologies and continuous improvement practices
* Manage operational performance data, monitor KPIs and OKRs, and analyze production and logistics processes to identify inefficiencies and implement data-driven improvements

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a closely related field
* Many years of professional experience in project execution, production, or logistics within a manufacturing environment
* Lean Training or a Lean Certification and/or Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Strong expertise in Lean methodologies, Six Sigma tools, value stream mapping, process optimization, root cause analysis, and problem solving
* Experience in project planning and execution, workshop facilitation, stakeholder and change management, performance monitoring, and cost analysis
* Very good communication in English and German

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity

In this role, you will collaborate closely with internationally recognized physicians, Key Opinion Leaders, and leading global partners in the Structural Heart and Electrophysiology space. You will support a broad range of advanced procedures, including transcatheter valve interventions, left atrial appendage (LAA) closure, electrophysiology procedures, and emerging therapies. At the same time, you will help shape the future of interventional imaging by incorporating direct customer feedback and driving clinical innovation in one of the fastest-growing fields of cardiovascular medicine.

This position can be filled within Germany.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

Drive Clinical Adoption
* You lead the successful clinical adoption of AcuNav Lumos 4D ICE and Interventional Ultrasound technologies across EMEA.
* You support physicians and cath lab/EP teams by providing expert clinical and technical guidance during procedures and enabling the effective use of the AcuNav Lumos 4D ICE Catheter and interventional ultrasound technologies.

Develop Education and Training
* You create and deliver high-quality training programs and educational content for customers as well as internal commercial and clinical teams, while maintaining deep expertise in the clinical application of intracardiac echocardiography.
* You support major international congresses, customer events, and educational initiatives across EMEA, including hands-on workshops, simulation training, and clinical demonstrations.

Collaborate Across the Structural Heart Ecosystem
* You work closely with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), build trusted relationships, and act as the voice of the customer by gathering clinical insights and supporting continuous product improvement.
* You partner with commercial, marketing, product management, and R&D teams to share clinical feedback and contribute to ongoing innovation and product development.

Support Commercial Success
* You provide clinical expertise to identify customer needs and collaborate with commercial teams to drive successful adoption and account growth.
* You contribute to go-to-market initiatives and customer engagement strategies.

* Do you already have many years of sound professional experience e.g. as clinical application specialist or Cath Lab Nurse and further qualifications in this field, but no degree? Then we also look forward to receiving your application.
* You possess strong expertise in advanced cardiac imaging, including solid knowledge of TEE, 3D/4D echocardiography and preferably ICE.
* You have a proven track record of delivering impactful product demonstrations, providing clinical education, and leading physician training sessions in complex clinical environments.
* You bring expert knowledge of clinical procedures, workflow optimization, best practices, troubleshooting techniques, scientific literature, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

This position involves the technical and disciplinary leadership of a team of IT/OT technicians, the coordination of IT/OT projects, and the responsibility for maintaining and further developing the local IT/OT infrastructure.
The Local IT Team Lead works closely with other departments to ensure the seamless and high quality delivery of IT/OT services. In addition, he or she, together with the team, is integrated into global support and project structures and provides support for international initiatives as required.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Leadership, guidance, and performance management of the local IT/OT team, including mentoring and feedback
* Coordination and prioritization of local and global IT/OT support requests, including first‑ and second‑line technical support
* Setup, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of local and global IT/OT infrastructure (servers, networks, security systems, and end‑user devices)
* Planning, leadership, and execution of local and international IT/OT projects and strategic initiatives
* Cross‑functional collaboration with internal departments and the global IT organization to ensure stable operation of the global DT environment and remote site support
* Compliance assurance with IT/OT policies and best practices, including documentation, ticket tracking, continuous process improvement, and evaluation of emerging technologies

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline
* Proven experience in IT/OT support or a comparable role, with leadership experience as an advantage
* Strong knowledge of IT/OT systems, hardware, software, networking, and troubleshooting methodologies
* Familiarity with IT service management frameworks (e.g. ITIL), relevant certifications (e.g. CompTIA A+, Network+), and SAP knowledge as a plus
* Proficiency in the local language and English; additional language skills as an advantage
* Strong personal attributes, including problem‑solving capability, communication skills, attention to detail, customer orientation, adaptability, a hands‑on mindset, and commitment to continuous learning 

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
**The following challenges await you:** 

- You will join the newly established Corporate Development function as a key sparring partner, shaping the long-term strategic direction of Heraeus Convantics through 2035.
- From day one, you will engage with both CEOs and the Leadership Team on the questions that matter most: where to grow, where to focus, which new business fields to build, and how to position the company in a changing market environment.
- In this role, you will take topics end-to-end – from structuring and analyzing complex problems & trends to translating findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior leadership. Selected strategic initiatives will be delegated to you with full execution responsibility, so you can see your work translate into real outcomes.
- You will work across all five Business Lines, collaborate closely with leaders from across the organization, and engage with external partners as needed. Topics will range from new business field development and footprint decisions to portfolio choices and strategic M&A evaluations – with a future-back perspective focused on long-term value creation.
- Beyond your day-to-day work on strategic topics, you will help shape how the function operates from the ground up – defining methodologies and establishing Corporate Development as a high-impact contributor to the company’s long-term direction. For ambitious people with clear leadership ambitions, this is a role designed to build board strategic depth and open the path to future leadership responsibility.

Your Profile:

- Master's degree (or equivalent) in business, economics, management, engineering, or a related field
- 3–5 years of professional experience, ideally with a foundation in strategy consulting, complemented by industry experience and/or corporate development exposure
- Proven track record on complex strategic projects with senior-management visibility – ideally including portfolio strategy, new business development, or transformation work
- High ownership mindset – comfortable taking topics from initial structuring all the way to actionable recommendations, with strong personal accountability
- Driven by curiosity – a genuine interest for Semiconductors, Datacom, Photonics, Materials, AI and emerging future trends, paired with the ability to quickly build expertise in unfamiliar topics and industries
- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills – ability to structure ambiguity and translate insights into actionable recommendations
- Confident communicator – able to produce high-quality strategic content and engage credibly with senior stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
- Leadership ambition – this role offers a clear development path for those who want to grow into a broader scope
- Comfortable working across cultures, functions and global locations
- Business-fluent in English, German is a strong plus

What you can look forward to at Heraeus Covantics:

- Attractive compensation – in addition to a competitive salary package, you’ll benefit from comprehensive benefits offered by a responsible family-owned company
- Flexible time off – 30 days of annual leave plus up to 6 additional days off (company holidays on long weekends and between Christmas and New Year’s), special leave for special occasions, and a lifetime working time account for paid time off (e.g., early retirement)
- Sustainability & social commitment – sustainability as an integral part of the corporate strategy, as well as targeted support for educational, family, and scientific initiatives through our own foundations
- Modern workplace – ergonomic workspace in an open-plan office with modern equipment, a laptop of your choice, two additional monitors, an iPhone (also for personal use), and height-adjustable desks
- Additional benefits – subsidies for public transportation, discounts at numerous (online) stores, an on-site medical service with comprehensive preventive health checkups, sports programs, and an employee cafeteria with meals freshly prepared daily

Ipsos Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. Ipsos Healthcare is the world's leading provider of quantitative and qualitative market research studies in the pharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. The focus is on doctors, medical professionals, and, above all, patients. Our range of solutions is very diverse and covers traditional primary market research as well as scientific Real-World Evidence studies. In collaboration with our national and international clients, we conduct studies along the entire lifecycle of a healthcare product, from early demand and quality-of-life studies to projects for the preparation and accompaniment of product launches (including success measurements) and studies that help already launched products or approved preparations achieve greater success. We are looking for a Senior Insights Consultant (f/m/d) for our Healthcare team at one of our locations in Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Nuremberg or Munich. Your role You will be part of a team managing a multi-national big tracking program, managing local clients and global stakeholders. After your onboarding time, you will be responsible for leading the project setup & design, the client conversations and the team (functionally) for one of the product categories. You accompany and manage quantitative market research projects from conception to delivery on a national and international level. You support the consulting of clients regarding project design and methodological questions. You independently create proposals and calculations for study designs. You handle the coordination of project phases and work closely with internal interfaces as well as external service providers. You analyze study results, create meaningful reports, and present the results confidently to clients. You actively participate in the creation of pitch presentations and the expansion of existing client relationships. You work cross-departmentally within Ipsos Germany and maintain close exchange with global and European healthcare teams. Your profile You hold a university degree, preferably in business administration (focus on marketing/market research), social sciences, psychology, communication science, health science/public health, or a comparable field. You have 2-3 years of relevant experience in market research (institute or client side), ideally in healthcare, pharma, or medical technology. You have excellent knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, as well as strong understanding of advanced analytical techniques - but focus on recommending the right approaches and clearly explaining results, implications, and limitations to non-technical stakeholders rather than running analyses yourself. You demonstrate strong client management, communication, and storytelling skills, combined with analytical thinking and organizational strength. You are experienced in using modern project management tools and approaches. You are fluent in English; good level of German is preferred. You are open-minded, innovation-driven, and motivated to improve processes and efficiencies. You approach challenges with a proactive and confident mindset, navigating complex and unfamiliar situations effectively. You are a team player with flexibility and creativity. You have very good IT user skills, particularly in Office 365. What we offer At Ipsos, you can expect an international and innovative working environment. We serve renowned clients across almost all major industries and work on exciting projects worldwide! You can look forward to: Hybrid work Flexible working hours Workation in European countries Ipsos Corporate Benefits Subsidy for the Germany public transport ticket (Deutschlandticket) Job rotation opportunities Development & learning culture International collaboration Events & local community Diversity & inclusion initiatives Corporate social responsibility programs Modern workplace Interested? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your application (CV, certificates, and optional a short cover letter) including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations.
